seo.title: Global Reach
seo.description: Autumn Star's international shipping focus: ocean freight worldwide, connected by air and ground. Ask about your trade lane.

hero.title: Global reach
hero.text: International shipping is at the centre of what we do.
hero.imageAlt: Container port at sunset, seen from above

intro: Autumn Star focuses on international freight, moving goods by sea between countries, with air and ground transportation to connect the legs before and after.

pillars.title: Ocean freight worldwide
pillars.text: Our primary focus: international sea shipments for businesses that trade across borders.

pillars.title: Air when it matters
pillars.text: International air cargo for shipments that need to move faster.

pillars.title: Connected on the ground
pillars.text: Trucking, parcel and last-mile moves link ports and airports to your door.

lanes.title: Ask about your trade lane
lanes.text: Service regions and routes are confirmed with each request. Tell us where your goods are coming from and going to, and we'll tell you how we can help.
lanes.imageAlt: Container ship being loaded at a terminal, seen from above
